title: MACP Receipt Verification Keys
description: The JWK Set [RFC 7517] a runtime returns from GetReceiptKeys (RFC-MACP-0013 §13): the public keys that verify the jws attestations of the decision receipts it issues. Every key names a kid and a kty; an OKP key is an Ed25519 public key with its x coordinate; no key carries the private member d or the symmetric secret k (every EC, OKP or RSA private key carries d, and every oct key carries k; the other private RSA members are listed in §13 item 8). Other key types are allowed, so a later revision that admits ES256 is additive. kid uniqueness across the set is required by §13 item 8 but is not expressible here. An empty set ({"keys": []}) is valid: it is what a runtime with no signing key publishes.

keys.description: The verification keys. Every key that signed a receipt the runtime still serves stays in this set (§13 item 8).

jwk.description: One public JWK. Members not named here (alg, use, key_ops, ...) are allowed, as RFC 7517 allows them.

kid.description: Key identifier, matched against the kid of a jws attestation's protected header. Unique in the set and never reused for a different key.

kty.description: Key type [RFC 7517 §4.1]. OKP is the Ed25519 type used by EdDSA.

alg.description: The JWS algorithm this key signs with, e.g. EdDSA. A verifier learns the runtime's algorithms from these entries.

x.description: The Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding [RFC 8037].
